_note: A {@render} call goes through a wrapper whose parameter is the value a Svelte snippet returns, so rendering a plain function (returning void or string) is TS2345 at the call. A standalone snippet declares that snippet-return type (TS: annotation, JS: JSDoc @returns), so passing it to a prop typed () => string is TS2322. An animate: call is wrapped so its result must be an animation config: a function returning a thunk or a number is TS2559, and an arity error on the element/move arguments lands on the last character of the directive name. Positions verified against upstream svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55.
